messages:
simone: Heads-up — staging run with kernel v3.2.1+quant produced intermittent OOMs on p3-8xlarge around 02:12. I'm pausing the night rollout. Thoughts?

deploybot: preflight results uploaded: https://ci.redwood/run/23910123 — 7/9 checks passed, kv-cache memory high on 2 workers, stacktrace snippet in artifacts. :warning:

cheng: I replayed the failing shard locally, reproduced OOM w/ seq_len=2048 and batch=64. Seems tied to matmul kernel path when quantized.

ryan: Is this the new fused-matmul kernel? We toggled that on in the feature flag last night.

cheng: yep — fused-matmul + int8 quant combo. Without quant the replay is clean.

alex: Can we gate by model/slot? Maybe route heavy seq_len traffic to non-quant variant until we fix kernel. 5% canary seems risky.

maria: For rollout plan: we need explicit rollback triggers in release notes. Propose automatic pin if <90% success on canary for 10m or any OOMs >0.

simone: Agreed on rollback triggers. Two options: 1) delay main rollout until AM (ops handover), 2) proceed with a tiny canary (2%) with strict observability and immediate pin on OOM. Leaning toward 2) to keep schedule but conservative.

ryan: If we do 2%, we should pre-bake a pin command and make sure deploybot accepts emergency pins. Example pin: `deploybot pin kernel v3.2.0 --reason \"ooms on quant fused-matmul\"`

deploybot: Confirmed: emergency pin command exists and requires 1 approver from eng-runtime and oncall. Usage: ```deploybot pin <package> <version> --reason \"...\"```

cheng: I'm +1 for 2% with immediate pin criteria. I'll add a lightweight smoke harness that targets seq_len edgecases and stream it to the canary group.

alex: +1 for 2% but add a 1m aggregated latency and OOM alert to PagerDuty. If pager fires, auto-pin.

maria: I'll draft the release note blurb and rollback section now. Include steps: how to pin, contact matrix, telemetry dashboards to monitor (kv-cache, mem cgroup, OOM count, p50/p99).

simone: Vote check: proceed 2% canary now? react with :thumbsup: to proceed, :thumbsdown: to delay to AM.

ryan: :thumbsup:

cheng: :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

simone: All thumbs up. Starting 2% canary in 30s. Deploybot — kickoff.

deploybot: kickoff accepted. Canary split: 2% -> 2
Routes: quant-fused -> v3.2.1; fallback route to v3.2.0 on pin. Monitoring window: 15m. Alerts set.

simone: I'll stay on watch for the next 30m and update the spin if anything shows. If OOM appears anywhere, I will pin immediately and post steps.

cheng: smoke harness kicking off now, logs streaming to #eng-runtime-smoke.

(30s later)

deploybot: canary progress: 0/2 OOMs so far, 1200 requests routed, avg latency +3ms vs baseline. Continuing.

simone: Good. Keeping watch. Maria, send the release note draft to #release-drafts when ready.

maria: Draft posted. Included pin command, PD escalation names, and canary criteria. Ready for review.

(14m later)

deploybot: canary final: 15m window complete, no OOMs, success metrics within thresholds. Canary -> promote rollouts per schedule.

simone: Promoting to 25% now. Will monitor next window and then full. Thanks all.

alex: Nice. Follow-up: open ticket to investigate fused-matmul int8 edgecase for seq_len>1024, assign cheng.

cheng: Ticket created: ENG-4721. I'll start root-cause tomorrow.

simone: Closing thread — great coordination. :rocket:
